account-cancel.title: How do I cancel my subscription?
account-cancel.body:
TRUEVISIONS NOW

How to cancel your subscription

TrueVisions NOW Help • 2:47

You can cancel your TrueVisions NOW subscription at any time with no cancellation fees. Your access continues until the end of your current billing period.

To cancel on web

  1. 1Sign in at truevisionsnow.com and click your profile picture in the top-right corner.
  2. 2Select Account Settings from the dropdown menu.
  3. 3Scroll to the Subscription section and click Cancel Plan.

To cancel on mobile

  1. 1Open the TrueVisions NOW app and tap your profile icon.
  2. 2Go to Settings > Manage Subscription.
  3. 3Tap Cancel Subscription and follow the prompts.

Note

If you subscribed through the App Store (iOS) or Google Play, you must cancel directly through Apple or Google — not through our app or website.

account-payment.title: How do I update my payment method or card?
account-payment.body:
You can add, change, or remove a payment method from your account settings at any time.

  1. 1Sign in and go to Account Settings > Payment Methods.
  2. 2Click Add New Card or select an existing card to edit.
  3. 3Enter your new card details and click Save.
  4. 4To set it as your default, click Set as Default next to the card.

Tip

We accept Visa, Mastercard, and PromptPay QR. Bank transfers are available for annual plans — contact support to arrange.

Note

Updating your payment method does not trigger an immediate charge. The new card will be used on your next billing date.

account-invoices.title: Where can I find my invoices and receipts?
account-invoices.body:
All your billing history and receipts are available in your account, going back to your first payment.

  1. 1Sign in and click your profile icon, then select Account Settings.
  2. 2Click the Billing History tab.
  3. 3Find the invoice you need and click Download PDF to save it.

Receipts are also emailed to you automatically on each billing date. Check your spam folder if you cannot find them.

Tip

If you need a tax invoice with your company details, email support@truevisionsnow.com with your company name and tax ID.

account-email-password.title: How do I change my email address or password?
account-email-password.body:
Change your password

  1. 1Go to Account Settings > Security.
  2. 2Click Change Password.
  3. 3Enter your current password, then your new password twice, and click Update.

Change your email address

  1. 1Go to Account Settings > Profile.
  2. 2Click the pencil icon next to your email address.
  3. 3Enter your new email and your current password to confirm.
  4. 4Check your new email inbox for a verification link and click it to complete the change.

Tip

If you have forgotten your password, use the password reset flow on the sign-in page instead.

account-charge-after-cancel.title: Why was I charged after cancelling?
account-charge-after-cancel.body:
There are a few reasons you may see a charge after cancelling:

Billing cycle timing

When you cancel, your plan stays active until the end of your current billing period. If your billing date fell just after you cancelled, that charge covers the final active period — it is not an error.

Third-party subscriptions

If you subscribed through the App Store or Google Play, cancelling through TrueVisions NOW does not cancel the App Store or Google Play billing. You must cancel directly in Apple or Google account settings.

Annual plan

Annual plans are charged upfront for the full year. If you cancel an annual plan mid-year, you keep access until the year ends but are not refunded for unused months by default. Contact support to discuss options.

Note

If you believe you were charged in error, email support@truevisionsnow.com with your account email and the charge amount and we will investigate within 1 business day.

account-reactivate.title: How do I reactivate a cancelled account?
account-reactivate.body:
You can reactivate your TrueVisions NOW subscription at any time. Your watchlist, preferences, and viewing history are saved for 12 months after cancellation.

  1. 1Go to truevisionsnow.com and sign in with your original email and password.
  2. 2You will see a banner offering to reactivate your plan. Click Reactivate.
  3. 3Choose a plan and confirm your payment method.
  4. 4Your access is restored immediately.

Tip

If it has been more than 12 months since you cancelled, your watch history will not be available but your account details will still be there.

account-family-sharing.title: Can I share my account with family members?
account-family-sharing.body:
Yes — TrueVisions NOW supports multiple profiles on a single account, so each family member can have their own watchlist, recommendations, and continue-watching queue.

How many profiles can I create?

All plans support up to 5 profiles. Each profile can be set with its own name and avatar. Kids profiles have automatic content restrictions applied.

Simultaneous streams

The number of screens that can stream at the same time depends on your plan. ENT 99 supports 1 screen, ENT 199 supports 2, Sports and Bundle plans support up to 3, and NOW MAX supports 5 simultaneous streams.

Tip

If someone outside your home needs access, upgrading to a Bundle or NOW MAX plan and adding an extra profile is the best option.

account-delete.title: How do I delete my account?
account-delete.body:
Deleting your account permanently removes your personal data, payment history, and viewing history from our systems. This action cannot be undone.

  1. 1First, cancel your active subscription to avoid future charges (see How to cancel).
  2. 2Go to Account Settings > Privacy.
  3. 3Click Delete My Account at the bottom of the page.
  4. 4Enter your password to confirm, then click Permanently Delete.
  5. 5You will receive a confirmation email. Deletion is processed within 30 days.

Note

If you subscribed via the App Store or Google Play, cancel your billing there separately before deleting your account here.

streaming-buffering.title: Why is my video buffering or stuttering?
streaming-buffering.body:
Buffering usually means your internet connection is slower than the stream needs. Try these steps in order.

  1. 1Check your speed. Run a speed test at fast.com. You need at least 5 Mbps for HD and 25 Mbps for 4K.
  2. 2Lower the video quality. In the player, tap the settings icon and choose a lower resolution such as 720p.
  3. 3Move closer to your router or connect via ethernet cable instead of Wi-Fi.
  4. 4Restart your router by unplugging it for 30 seconds.
  5. 5Close other apps or devices that may be using bandwidth at the same time.
  6. 6Clear the app cache. On Android, go to Settings > Apps > TrueVisions NOW > Clear Cache.

Tip

If buffering only happens during peak hours (evenings), this is likely network congestion from your ISP. Try watching at a different time or contact your internet provider.

streaming-quality.title: How do I improve video quality?
streaming-quality.body:
TrueVisions NOW automatically selects the best quality for your connection, but you can also set it manually.

Set quality manually

  1. 1While a video is playing, tap or click the Settings (gear) icon in the player controls.
  2. 2Select Quality and choose your preferred resolution (720p, 1080p, or 4K where available).

Make sure 4K is available

4K Ultra HD is only available on NOW MAX plan. Your TV or monitor must support 4K, and your HDMI cable must be HDMI 2.0 or higher. You also need at least 25 Mbps sustained download speed.

Tip

If you are watching on a Smart TV and quality seems low, try uninstalling and reinstalling the app, as an outdated version may cap the resolution.

streaming-app-crash.title: The app keeps crashing — what should I do?
streaming-app-crash.body:
App crashes are usually caused by an outdated app version, a full cache, or a software conflict. Work through these steps:

  1. 1Force-close the app completely and reopen it.
  2. 2Restart your device. This clears temporary memory issues.
  3. 3Update the app to the latest version via the App Store, Google Play, or your TV app store.
  4. 4Clear the cache. On Android: Settings > Apps > TrueVisions NOW > Storage > Clear Cache. On Smart TV: Settings > Apps > TrueVisions NOW > Clear Data.
  5. 5Uninstall and reinstall the app if the problem persists.

Note

If the app crashes only on a specific title, that content may have a temporary issue. Try a different title to confirm, then report the original using the in-app feedback option.

streaming-audio-sync.title: Why is the audio out of sync with the video?
streaming-audio-sync.body:
Audio sync issues are almost always fixed by one of these steps:

  1. 1Pause and play the video. This forces the player to re-sync.
  2. 2Seek backwards or forwards by 10 seconds, then resume.
  3. 3Switch audio track. Tap the settings icon in the player and select a different audio language, then switch back.
  4. 4Close the app fully and reopen it, then start the video again from where you left off (it will be saved in Continue Watching).
  5. 5If using a Bluetooth speaker or headphones, reconnect the Bluetooth device. Bluetooth can introduce audio delay.

Tip

If sync problems persist on a specific title, report it via Settings > Help > Report an Issue so our team can investigate.

streaming-subtitles.title: How do I enable subtitles or change audio language?
streaming-subtitles.body:
Most TrueVisions NOW titles offer Thai and English subtitles, and many international titles include dubbed audio tracks.

Turn on subtitles

  1. 1Start playing a video.
  2. 2Tap the speech bubble or CC icon in the player controls.
  3. 3Select your preferred subtitle language.

Change audio language

  1. 1Tap the settings (gear) icon in the player.
  2. 2Select Audio and choose a language from the available options.

Subtitle appearance

You can customise subtitle size, colour, and background. Go to Account Settings > Subtitles to change the default appearance across all content.

Note

Not all titles have multiple audio languages. The number of subtitle and audio options depends on the licence for each piece of content.

streaming-speed.title: What internet speed do I need for streaming?
streaming-speed.body:
Here are the recommended speeds for each quality level:

QualityMin. SpeedRecommended
SD (480p)2 Mbps3 Mbps
HD (720p)5 Mbps8 Mbps
Full HD (1080p)10 Mbps15 Mbps
4K UHD (NOW MAX only)25 Mbps40 Mbps

Tip

These speeds are per stream. If multiple people stream simultaneously, multiply accordingly. A home with 3 HD streams needs at least 24 Mbps total.

Run a speed test at fast.com. If your speed is lower than expected, restart your router or contact your ISP.

streaming-quality-drop.title: Why does the video quality drop automatically?
streaming-quality-drop.body:
TrueVisions NOW uses adaptive bitrate streaming, which automatically adjusts video quality based on your available bandwidth. This prevents buffering but may lower the picture quality when your connection weakens.

Common causes

Quality drops happen when: other devices on your network are downloading or streaming simultaneously; you are on Wi-Fi far from your router; your ISP slows speeds during peak hours (typically 6–10pm); or your mobile data signal weakens.

How to lock quality

  1. 1Tap the gear icon in the player while a video is playing.
  2. 2Select Quality and choose a specific resolution instead of Auto.

Note

Locking to a high quality on a slow connection will cause buffering. Only lock quality if your connection is stable enough to sustain it.

streaming-report-issue.title: How do I report a broken or missing episode?
streaming-report-issue.body:
If you find a technical problem with content — a broken video, missing episode, wrong subtitles, or mismatched audio — please report it so we can fix it quickly.

Report via the app

  1. 1Navigate to the affected title and tap the three-dot menu (or long-press on mobile).
  2. 2Select Report a Problem.
  3. 3Choose the issue type and add any details, then tap Submit.

Report via email

Email support@truevisionsnow.com with the title name, episode number (if applicable), and a description of the issue. Screenshots are helpful.

Tip

Content issues are usually resolved within 24–48 hours. Our team monitors reports continuously and prioritises live sports content.

devices-supported.title: Which devices support TrueVisions NOW?
devices-supported.body:
TrueVisions NOW works on virtually any screen. Here is a full list of supported platforms:

Mobile & tablet

iPhone and iPad (iOS 14 or later) • Android phones and tablets (Android 8.0 or later)

TV & living room

Samsung Smart TV (2018 or newer) • LG Smart TV (webOS 4.0 or newer) • Android TV / Google TV • Apple TV (4th generation or newer, tvOS 14+) • Amazon Fire TV Stick (2nd generation or newer) • Chromecast with Google TV • Chromecast (2nd generation or newer, cast from phone)

Computer

Web browser: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge (latest 2 versions) • No desktop app is required — stream directly at truevisionsnow.com

Gaming consoles

PlayStation 4 and PS5 • Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S

If your device is not listed, try opening truevisionsnow.com in its web browser. Most modern smart TVs with a built-in browser can stream this way.

On Samsung and LG TVs made before 2018, the app may not be available in the TV store. Use a Chromecast or Fire TV Stick plugged into an HDMI port instead.

devices-chromecast-appletv.title: How do I set up Chromecast or Apple TV?
devices-chromecast-appletv.body:
Chromecast

  1. 1Make sure your phone and Chromecast are on the same Wi-Fi network.
  2. 2Open the TrueVisions NOW app on your phone.
  3. 3Tap the Cast icon (top-right corner of the player or home screen).
  4. 4Select your Chromecast device from the list.
  5. 5Press play on any content — it will stream to your TV. Control playback from your phone.

Apple TV

  1. 1On your Apple TV, open the App Store.
  2. 2Search for TrueVisions NOW and install it.
  3. 3Open the app and sign in with your account credentials.

Tip

Apple TV 4K gives the best picture quality, including Dolby Vision where available. Make sure your HDMI cable supports HDMI 2.1 for 4K/60fps.

devices-new-device-login.title: How do I log in on a new device?
devices-new-device-login.body:
You can log in on a new device in two ways: directly with your email and password, or via a QR code on TV.

Email and password

  1. 1Open the TrueVisions NOW app on your new device.
  2. 2Tap Sign In.
  3. 3Enter your account email and password, then tap Sign In.

QR code (TV only)

  1. 1Open the app on your TV and select Sign In.
  2. 2Choose Sign in with phone to show a QR code.
  3. 3Open the TrueVisions NOW app on your phone and scan the code.
  4. 4Your TV is logged in instantly — no typing required.

Note

Your account allows a maximum of 5 registered devices. If you have reached the limit, remove an old device first under Account Settings > Manage Devices.

devices-remove-device.title: How do I remove a device from my account?
devices-remove-device.body:
If you have reached your device limit or you no longer use a device, you can remove it from your account.

  1. 1Sign in at truevisionsnow.com and go to Account Settings > Manage Devices.
  2. 2You will see a list of all devices currently logged in to your account.
  3. 3Click Remove next to the device you want to deregister.
  4. 4Confirm the removal. The device will be signed out immediately.

Tip

If you cannot identify a device, click the device name to see the last login time and location. If it looks unfamiliar, remove it and change your password.

Note

You can have up to 5 devices registered at a time. Removing a device does not affect any other devices or your subscription.

devices-app-wont-open.title: Why won't the app open on my phone?
devices-app-wont-open.body:
If the TrueVisions NOW app fails to open, shows a blank screen, or freezes on the splash screen, try these steps:

  1. 1Force-close the app and reopen it. On iPhone, swipe up and swipe away the app. On Android, tap the square button and swipe it away.
  2. 2Restart your phone.
  3. 3Check for app updates in the App Store or Google Play and install any available update.
  4. 4Check your internet connection. Open a browser and load a website to confirm connectivity.
  5. 5Clear the cache. On Android: Settings > Apps > TrueVisions NOW > Storage > Clear Cache.
  6. 6Uninstall and reinstall the app. Your account data will not be lost.

Note

If the app stopped working after a system update on your phone, wait 24 hours. A compatibility update for the app usually follows within a day.

devices-update-app.title: How do I update the TrueVisions NOW app?
devices-update-app.body:
Keeping the app up to date ensures you have the latest features, performance improvements, and security fixes.

iPhone and iPad

  1. 1Open the App Store and tap your profile picture.
  2. 2Scroll down to Available Updates.
  3. 3Find TrueVisions NOW and tap Update.

Android

  1. 1Open the Google Play Store.
  2. 2Tap your profile icon > Manage apps & device.
  3. 3Find TrueVisions NOW in the list and tap Update.

Smart TV

Open your TV's app store (Samsung Apps, LG Content Store, Google Play Store, etc.), go to My Apps or Updates, and update TrueVisions NOW from there.

Tip

Enable automatic updates on your phone so the app always stays current without manual action.

devices-web-browser.title: Can I watch on a web browser?
devices-web-browser.body:
Yes — you can stream TrueVisions NOW directly from any modern web browser. No app or plug-in download is needed.

Visit truevisionsnow.com, sign in, and start watching. The browser experience includes the full content library, subtitles, quality selection, and your watchlist.

Supported browsers

Chrome 90+ • Firefox 88+ • Safari 14+ • Microsoft Edge 90+

4K on browser

4K playback in browser requires Chrome on Windows or Mac, a display capable of 4K, and a stable connection of 25 Mbps or more.

Tip

For the best browser experience on a large screen, use Chrome and go full-screen by pressing F11 (Windows) or Ctrl+Shift+F (Mac).

Note

Internet Explorer is not supported. If you are using IE, please switch to Edge, Chrome, or Firefox.

plans-ent-vs-sports.title: What is the difference between Entertainment and Sports plans?
plans-ent-vs-sports.body:
Entertainment plans

Entertainment plans give you access to movies, Thai and international TV series, kids content, lifestyle channels, and TrueVisions NOW Originals. Plans start at ฿99/month (ENT 99).

Sports plans

Sports plans include live and on-demand sports coverage: Muay Thai, Thai League 1, Premier League, Champions League, La Liga, Formula 1, tennis, golf, and more. Sports plans start at ฿149/month (Muay Thai).

Bundle plans

Bundle plans give you both Entertainment and Sports content together at a reduced combined price, starting at ฿399/month (Football + Entertainment). The NOW MAX plan at ฿1,599/month is our all-inclusive, everything-included tier.

Compare all plans

plans-upgrade-downgrade.title: How do I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
plans-upgrade-downgrade.body:
1. 1Sign in and go to Account Settings > Subscription.
  2. 2Click Change Plan.
  3. 3Select your new plan from the list.
  4. 4Review the price difference and click Confirm Change.

When does it take effect?

Upgrades take effect immediately. You get instant access to the new plan's content, and the price difference is added to your next bill on a pro-rated basis.

Downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle. You keep your current plan's access until then.

Tip

If you are downgrading to a plan that does not include a content category you have downloaded for offline viewing, those downloads will become unavailable when the downgrade takes effect.

plans-max-bundle.title: What is included in the NOW MAX plan?
plans-max-bundle.body:
NOW MAX is the premium all-in-one plan at ฿1,599/month. It includes everything in Entertainment and Sports, plus exclusive extras.

What is included

Full Entertainment library (movies, series, originals, kids, lifestyle) • Full Sports library (all Muay Thai, football, multi-sport) • Unlimited 4K Ultra HD streaming • 5 simultaneous streams • Offline downloads on up to 5 devices • Early access to new releases • Premium customer support with priority queue

Annual plan saving

Choose the annual NOW MAX plan and pay ฿1,299/month (billed as ฿15,588 once per year) — a saving of ฿3,600 versus monthly billing.

Tip

NOW MAX is the only plan that includes 4K HDR and Dolby Vision content where available.

plans-renewal-date.title: When does my billing date change after upgrading?
plans-renewal-date.body:
Your billing date stays the same when you upgrade. The upgrade is charged on a pro-rated basis: you pay only for the days remaining in the current cycle at the new plan's daily rate, minus the unused days of your old plan.

Example

You are on ENT 199 (฿199/month) and upgrade to Sports (฿299/month) on day 15 of a 30-day cycle. You have 15 days remaining. The pro-rated charge is: (฿299 − ฿199) × 15/30 = ฿50 added to your next bill.

Tip

You can always check your next billing amount in Account Settings > Subscription before confirming a plan change.

plans-add-sports.title: Can I add Sports to my Entertainment plan?
plans-add-sports.body:
You can access both Entertainment and Sports content by upgrading to a Bundle plan rather than running two separate subscriptions.

Bundle options

Football + Entertainment at ฿399/month gives you the full Entertainment library plus Premier League, Champions League, Muay Thai, and Thai League 1 coverage.

NOW MAX at ฿1,599/month gives you all content across Entertainment and every Sport tier, plus 4K and 5 screens.

How to switch to a Bundle

  1. 1Go to Account Settings > Subscription > Change Plan.
  2. 2Select a Bundle plan.
  3. 3Confirm the change. Your new content is accessible immediately.

plans-compare.title: How do I compare all available packages?
plans-compare.body:
The easiest way to compare plans is on our dedicated Compare page, which shows a side-by-side breakdown of all Entertainment, Sports, and Bundle plans.

Open Compare Plans

What the Compare page shows

For each plan you will see the monthly price, annual price, number of simultaneous streams, download allowance, video quality (HD or 4K), and a full feature checklist.

Tip

Toggle between Monthly and Annual billing on the Compare page to see the yearly saving for each plan. Annual plans save up to 20%.

plans-family.title: Is there a family or multi-screen plan?
plans-family.body:
All TrueVisions NOW plans support multiple profiles, but the number of screens that can stream at the same time varies by plan.

For a household of 3 or more people watching different content at the same time, NOW MAX at ฿1,599/month offers the best value per screen.

plans-live-tv.title: Do plans include live TV channels?
plans-live-tv.body:
Yes — select plans include access to linear live TV channels alongside the on-demand library.

Entertainment plans

ENT 199 and ENT 299 include live Thai general entertainment channels (TrueVisions channels 1–9), news channels, and lifestyle channels. ENT 99 is on-demand only.

Sports plans

All Sports plans include live sports channels with real-time coverage. Matches are also available on-demand after broadcast for up to 30 days.

NOW MAX

NOW MAX includes all live channels from Entertainment and Sports tiers, plus international news and premium sports channels not available on lower-tier plans.

Tip

Check the Channel Guide in the app (Home > Live TV) to see what is broadcasting now and what is coming up in the next 7 days.

parental-age-rating.title: How do I restrict content by age rating?
parental-age-rating.body:
TrueVisions NOW uses Thai broadcast content ratings and international film ratings. You can set a maximum rating, above which a PIN is required.

Available rating levels

G — Suitable for all ages • PG — Parental guidance • 13+ — Suitable for age 13 and over • 18+ — Adults only

  1. 1Go to Account Settings > Parental Controls.
  2. 2Under Content Rating, select the maximum allowed rating (e.g., PG).
  3. 3Any content above that rating will require your PIN to play.

Note

Rating restrictions apply to all profiles on your account unless a profile is set as an adult profile with parental controls disabled for that profile.

parental-kids-profile.title: How do I create a Kids profile?
parental-kids-profile.body:
A Kids profile automatically restricts content to G and PG-rated titles and shows a child-friendly interface with larger thumbnails and simplified navigation.

  1. 1Go to Account Settings > Profiles.
  2. 2Click Add Profile.
  3. 3Enter a name and choose a profile picture.
  4. 4Toggle Kids Profile to ON.
  5. 5Click Save Profile.

The Kids profile is now available on the profile selection screen when the app opens.

Tip

Kids profiles cannot be accessed without switching profiles first, and switching away from a Kids profile requires the account holder's parental PIN if one is set.

parental-block-content.title: Can I block specific shows or movies?
parental-block-content.body:
In addition to age-rating based restrictions, you can block specific titles so they never appear in search results, recommendations, or browsing.

  1. 1Navigate to the title you want to block.
  2. 2Click or tap the three-dot menu next to the title.
  3. 3Select Block This Title.
  4. 4If prompted, enter your parental PIN.

Blocked titles will not appear on any profile on your account. To unblock a title, go to Account Settings > Parental Controls > Blocked Titles.

Note

This feature applies account-wide, not per-profile. If you want to block something only for a child's profile, use a Kids Profile instead, which automatically hides all non-child content.

parental-change-pin.title: How do I change or reset my parental PIN?
parental-change-pin.body:
Change your PIN

  1. 1Go to Account Settings > Parental Controls.
  2. 2Click Change PIN.
  3. 3Enter your current PIN, then your new 4-digit PIN twice.
  4. 4Click Save.

Reset a forgotten PIN

  1. 1On the PIN prompt screen, click Forgot PIN?
  2. 2Enter your account password to verify it is you.
  3. 3Create a new PIN.

Tip

If you cannot remember your account password either, reset it first via the Sign In page > Forgot Password, then come back to reset your parental PIN.

parental-all-devices.title: Will parental controls apply on all devices?
parental-all-devices.body:
Yes — parental control settings are stored on your account, not on individual devices. Any PIN, content rating restriction, or blocked title applies everywhere your account is signed in.

This means a restriction set on your phone will also be active on your TV, tablet, browser, and any other logged-in device.

Tip

If you want a device to be completely unrestricted (for example, your personal phone), create a separate adult profile and set that as the default for that device. The child can only access the Kids profile, which is always restricted.

parental-profile-switch.title: How do I prevent profile switching without a PIN?
parental-profile-switch.body:
By default, anyone can switch between profiles without a PIN. You can lock profile switching so a PIN is required to switch away from a Kids profile.

  1. 1Go to Account Settings > Parental Controls.
  2. 2Enable Require PIN to switch profiles.
  3. 3Enter your parental PIN to confirm.

After enabling this, anyone using a Kids profile will need the PIN to access any other profile.

Note

This setting only restricts switching FROM a Kids profile. Switching between adult profiles does not require a PIN unless you also enable the separate adult profile PIN lock option.

parental-kids-content.title: Where can I find child-friendly content?
parental-kids-content.body:
TrueVisions NOW has a dedicated Kids section with cartoons, animated films, educational content, and family movies, all rated G.

Access Kids content

From the home screen, tap Kids in the top navigation, or switch to a Kids Profile for an interface designed specifically for children.

Featured categories

Animated series • Disney and international animated films • Thai children's shows • Educational and nature documentaries • Family movies (G and PG)

Tip

In a Kids Profile, the interface shows large thumbnails, simple categories, and no search field for non-kids content. It is the safest viewing experience for young children.

downloads-how-to.title: How do I download content for offline viewing?
downloads-how-to.body:

How to download content for offline viewing

TrueVisions NOW Help • 3:15

You can download movies and episodes on the TrueVisions NOW mobile and tablet app to watch later without an internet connection.

  1. 1Open the TrueVisions NOW app on your phone or tablet.
  2. 2Find the movie or episode you want to download.
  3. 3Tap the Download icon (arrow pointing down) next to the title or episode.

downloads-which-plans.title: Which plans support offline downloads?
downloads-which-plans.body:
Offline downloads are available on ENT 199, ENT 299, all Sports plans, all Bundle plans, and NOW MAX.

The ENT 99 plan does not include offline downloads. If you are on ENT 99, upgrading to ENT 199 is the smallest step to unlock downloads.

downloads-expiry.title: How long does a downloaded title stay available?
downloads-expiry.body:
Downloaded titles are available for 30 days from the date of download. Once you start watching a downloaded title, you have 48 hours to finish it before it expires.

Renew a download

If a download is about to expire and you have not finished watching, delete and re-download it to reset the 30-day clock — as long as your subscription is still active.

Content licence expiry

Some titles may expire from downloads early if TrueVisions NOW's licence for that content ends. You will receive a notification 7 days before this happens.

Note

Downloaded content is tied to your account and device. It cannot be transferred or shared with another device or account.

downloads-limit.title: How many titles can I download at once?
downloads-limit.body:
The number of downloads you can store at one time depends on your plan (see Downloads by plan). But there are also device storage limits to consider.

Storage tips

A standard 1080p episode uses approximately 1.5–2.5 GB of storage. A 4K episode (NOW MAX only) uses approximately 4–7 GB. A full movie ranges from 3 GB (HD) to 12 GB (4K).

  1. 1Go to My Downloads to see all saved content and how much storage it uses.
  2. 2Tap Delete on any title to free up space.
  3. 3Enable Smart Storage in Settings > Downloads to automatically remove watched downloads.

Tip

Choose HD downloads (720p) instead of 1080p or 4K to fit more content on your device without sacrificing too much quality.

downloads-no-button.title: Why can't I find the download button on some titles?
downloads-no-button.body:
Not all content on TrueVisions NOW is available for download. The download button will be missing for these types of content:

Live content

Live sports matches, live news, and live TV channels cannot be downloaded as they stream in real time.

Licencing restrictions

Some studios and content providers do not permit offline downloads of their content. This applies to a small selection of movies and series.

Plan limitation

If you are on ENT 99, downloads are not included. Upgrading to ENT 199 or higher unlocks the download button.

Content not yet released for download

Very new releases may have downloads temporarily disabled during their initial window on the platform.

Note

If you see the download button greyed out rather than absent, it usually means your plan does not include downloads for that quality level.

downloads-multiple-devices.title: Can I download on multiple devices?
downloads-multiple-devices.body:
Yes, depending on your plan, you can download on more than one device simultaneously.

ENT 199 allows downloads on 1 device. ENT 299 and Sports plans allow 3 devices. Bundle and NOW MAX plans allow 5 devices.

Each device counts separately. If you download on your phone and your tablet at the same time, that uses two of your device slots.

  1. 1Sign in on each device with your account.
  2. 2Navigate to the title and tap Download on each device independently.

Tip

If you hit your device download limit, go to My Downloads > Manage Devices and remove a device you no longer use to free a slot.

downloads-delete.title: How do I delete downloads to free up storage?
downloads-delete.body:
1. 1Open the TrueVisions NOW app and tap My Downloads in the bottom navigation.
  2. 2Find the title you want to remove.
  3. 3Tap the three-dot menu next to it and select Delete Download.
  4. 4Confirm the deletion.

Delete all downloads at once

  1. 1Go to Settings > Downloads.
  2. 2Tap Delete All Downloads and confirm.

Tip

Enable Smart Storage in Settings > Downloads to automatically remove downloads you have already watched, keeping your storage tidy.

Note

Deleting a download does not affect your subscription or your ability to re-download the title later.

downloads-early-expiry.title: Why did my downloaded content expire early?
downloads-early-expiry.body:
There are three reasons a download may expire before the standard 30 days:

You started watching it

Once you press play on a downloaded title, a 48-hour window starts. If you do not finish within 48 hours, the download expires even if the 30-day window has not ended.

Content licence ended

If TrueVisions NOW's streaming licence for a title expires, downloads of that content are automatically removed from all devices. We notify you 7 days in advance when possible.

Subscription lapsed

If your subscription was cancelled or a payment failed, downloaded content becomes unplayable until your subscription is active again.

Tip

To avoid losing a download mid-watch, always start a new download before beginning an important title, ensuring a fresh 48-hour window.
